verdict: Paid campaigns paused Sep 16; pipeline and organic traffic holding steady.
narrative: All paid advertising stopped on September 16 and has remained off for 14 consecutive days, meaning the 74 leads and $1,199 in spend this period were earned entirely in the first half of the window. The pause traces to a set of build milestones — including landing pages, CRM gaps, and a full-stack re-test — that need to be confirmed complete before campaigns restart cleanly. On a positive note, organic website sessions have continued to climb, averaging 37 per day over the last three days versus 24 the three days prior, so interest in Liferun is holding without paid support. Google Ads spent $288 this period with no recorded conversions; that budget is being redirected once the tracking infrastructure is verified. Campaigns are targeted to relaunch with improved conversion tracking in place, and next period should reflect a full 28 days of active spend.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta before the Sep 16 pause
cost per lead on Meta spend — a solid rate while it was running
new opportunities in the pipeline, with follow-up activation being prioritized now

watch_item.issue: Paid spend has been at $0 for 14 days, and Google Ads produced no conversions on $288 spent this period.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking and CRM money paths are being verified this week before campaigns go back live, so budget restarts on a confirmed foundation.
